FEED_THE_CAT.title: Feed the Cat
FEED_THE_CAT.pages.INITIAL.description: A cat sits beside an empty parfait glass and waits for the table to decide what kindness should cost.
FEED_THE_CAT.pages.INITIAL.options.VoteR: Vote for every player to receive a small reward route.
FEED_THE_CAT.pages.INITIAL.options.VoteP: Vote for every player to accept a penalty route.
FEED_THE_CAT.pages.WAITING.description: You have voted. The cat waits for everyone else's answer.

FEED_THE_CAT.pages.REWARD.description: The parfait is shared. Choose what remains with you.
FEED_THE_CAT.pages.REWARD.options.Remove: Choose a removable card from your deck and remove it.
FEED_THE_CAT.pages.REWARD.options.Upgrad: Choose an upgradable card from your deck and upgrade it.
FEED_THE_CAT.pages.PENALTY.description: The glass is empty. Choose how to pay for it.
FEED_THE_CAT.pages.PENALTY.options.GainD: Add a Debt curse to your deck.
